js.credentials.detail.revoked: Your coordinator ended this one. They can tell you more and help you with the next step.
js.credentials.detail.missing: Nothing is recorded for you yet. If a role you would like needs this, your coordinator can help you get started.

js.credentials.emptyListNote: If a list or a page that you used to see is empty, it can be because a credential is waiting to be renewed. It is not a mistake on your part, and only your coordinators can see these dates besides you.

orgs.consentPurposes.intro: What people in your organization can agree to, such as a newsletter or photos. When you change the text of a purpose, its version goes up and earlier consents show as given on an older version.

orgs.consentPurposes.guardian: A guardian must always give this consent

js.registers.waiting: You put this entry forward. A different registrar has to confirm it.
js.registers.confirmFinalize: Finalize this entry? It can never be edited or deleted afterwards. Corrections will be notes in the margin.
js.registers.confirmRequest: Put this entry forward? A different registrar must confirm it, and it cannot be edited after that without a new request.
js.registers.confirmConfirm: Confirm and finalize this entry? It can never be edited or deleted afterwards.
js.registers.requested: The entry is waiting for a second signer.
js.registers.stepUpFailed: The passkey check did not finish, so nothing was changed.
js.registers.loadFailed: The register could not be loaded. Try again later.
js.registers.noAccess: Only the registrars, owners and admins of this organization can open its registers.
js.registers.notMember: You are not a member of this organization.
js.registers.readOnly: You can read this register. Only a registrar can finalize entries and add notes.
js.registers.certFailed: The certificate could not be loaded.
js.registers.certNeedsFinal: Only a final entry has a certificate.
